text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- South Korea's Daewoo Corporation buys Hyatt Regency hotel in Rabat for $28.7 million and plans to invest more in renovations and extensions to hotel, and in other projects.
- Morocco and Spain to increase cooperation in battling drug trafficking, civil protection.
- King Hassan receives visiting French Regional Development, Public Works and Transport Minister Bernard Pons.
- Moroccan Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj calls on European Union to provide more financial backing.
- King Hassan welcomes new ambassadors and calls for all peoples to work for "peace, for an ideal of freedom and prosperity for the world", with particular reference to the Middle East.
- Two people carried away by floods, with more strong winds and heavy rains forecast for coastal areas of Morocco.
- Four Moroccans detained in southern France after seizure of seven kg (15.4 pounds) of heroin.
- Much remains for Morocco to do to become more competitive in the world, concludes meeting organised by Trade Ministry.
